name: Sales Desk
what: A tele-sales CRM built for a real Bangladeshi smart-board company, replacing a shared Google Sheet: agents work a daily call queue, log call results in one tap, and the manager sees team and ad-campaign performance.
hard_part: Migrated a live client spreadsheet of 10,141 leads into Go + MySQL, splitting each free-text comment cell into ordered follow-ups and verifying every row against an independent re-parse with zero mismatches. Leads are never deleted by design, and an in-portal Excel import with a dependency-free .xlsx reader previews, dedupes by phone and imports all-or-nothing.
status: Live · in use by the client (screens shown from the prototype with made-up sample data)
facts: 10,141 leads and 15,820 follow-up comments migrated from the client's sheet
Keyboard-first: 1–8 logs a call result, J/K moves through the queue
